card.title: IPhone 13 Pro and 13 Pro Max No Image Black Screen

source.title: IPhone 13 Pro and 13 Pro Max No Image Black Screen

claims.statement: iPhone 13 Pro / Pro Max no image: after a known-good screen, check the display FPC (often bowed out—gently bend back) and its diode readings.
Most common: PNVAR_DISPLAY_VGL (pin 1) shorted to ground when it should be OL—usually C9145 or C9146 by display PMIC U9100, or U9100 itself.
PNVAR_DISPLAY_VSSEL (pins 2, 4, 6) should also be OL; its caps are under the shield next to the NAND.
Display coils L9110, L9120, L9130, L9140 near the NAND can come loose; use low-temp solder to avoid floating the NAND.
U9100 (338S00616, used on iPhone 12–16) can crack/short; severe failures can short VDD_MAIN via L9130 and burn pads.

procedure: If VGL shorted, split and check C9145/C9146/U9100 with 1 V / 1 A.
Check VSSEL caps and wiggle-test L9110–L9140.
Replace U9100 and repair pads if needed.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Hot air near the display coils can float the NAND.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
